# Expected output variable: overall

# ===== DO NOT EDIT: LOCAL TEST FALLBACK START =====
if (!exists("midterm")) midterm <- 78
# ===== DO NOT EDIT: LOCAL TEST FALLBACK END =====

# ===== YOUR SOLUTION START =====
if (!exists("final")) final <- 91
if (!exists("rubric")) rubric <- c(86, 92, 88, 90)
project <- mean(rubric)
overall <- 0.35 * midterm + 0.45 * final + 0.20 * project
